title: Olympus OM-1 Basic CLA
description:
[Test Tutorial] A basic clean, lube and adjust (CLA) of the Olympus OM-1 35mm SLR camera, covering shutter speed accuracy, mirror damper replacement, and light seal replacement.
Test branch

steps.title: Remove the bottom plate
steps.intro: The bottom plate is held by three screws. They may be different lengths, so keep track of which came from where.

substeps.text: Remove the two bottom plate screws using a JIS #0 screwdriver. Note they may be different lengths — keep track of their positions.
Note the position of the governor spring before lifting the plate clear.

photos.alt: Bottom of the Olympus OM-1 showing the two plate screws and governor
Close-up of the bottom plate lifted clear, showing the film transport mechanism

steps.title: Check shutter speeds
steps.intro: Before cleaning anything, record the baseline shutter speed accuracy so you know what needs adjusting afterwards.

substeps.text: Place the camera in a shutter speed tester, or hold a smartphone microphone close to the shutter.
Fire each speed from B through 1/1000s and note any that are running slow.

photos.alt: Olympus OM-1 mounted in a Reveni Labs shutter speed tester
